        iDisclaimer

        This feature requires a GIS Pro or Enterprise subscription.

        Upgrade your plan to access live NSE & BSE financial data in Excel.

        We've moved to the ribbon
        Everything now lives on the GoIndia Stocks tab in the ribbon along the top of Excel — next to Home, Insert, Draw and Data.
        What changed
        The old Go India button on the Home tab has been removed. Instead of one side panel holding everything, each feature now has its own ribbon button:

        • Download Data — pick a company, choose data sources, build the AI model
        • Ask DataGPT — the research chat, opens full-width
        • Feedback — tell us about a company's data
        • Profile — your account, wallet balance and usage history
        • Log Out

        Nothing has been removed from the product — it's the same features, reached from the ribbon instead of a single panel.
